title: Femoral Fracture Plain Radiograph
author: Nevit Dilmen (talk)
caption: Plain radiograph demonstrating a displaced femoral fracture and surrounding soft-tissue alignment.
alt_text: X-ray radiograph showing a fractured human femur.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates radiographic presentation of femur fracture, which carries high RTDC and LOCL risk without surgical fixation (CLIFF-046, p.4-6).
